value.rationale: The unique 16-vertex SRG(16,5,0,2) is a canonical triangle-free distance-transitive folded cube. Its complete nonlinear excitation orbit census is a motivated benchmark; the exact appearance of 13- and 16-step clocks, eleven-step maximal transient, and two distinct longest-period spatial symmetry types encode structure beyond routine existence of cycles. Scope is precise and finite.
